v84: FAILS - two independent problems, either one fatal on its own:
     (1) classes are unsupported in IRGen at all (see 32-class-basic/versions.txt);
     (2) the "#x in obj" ergonomic private-brand-check syntax (a separate,
     later TC39 proposal than basic private fields) is not recognized by this
     build's parser at all ("invalid expression" -- a hard parse error, which
     is why compiling this exact file reports only ONE error instead of the
     many "private properties are not supported" errors seen on v94: the
     parse error aborts before semantic validation gets a chance to walk the
     rest of the private-field usages).
v94: FAILS - "private properties are not supported", reported once per every
     `#name` field/method declaration and use-site (14 occurrences in this
     file) -- react-native@0.72.17's hermesc parses private names but
     explicitly rejects them in its semantic validator. Also independently
     blocked by the lack of class support at all (see 32-class-basic).
v96: FAILS - identical "private properties are not supported" errors, same
     count and root cause as v94 (react-native@0.73.11's bundled hermesc,
     classic-Hermes `main` lineage, still rejects private names and still
     lacks class support at all).
v99: OK - hermes-compiler@260318099.0.1 fully supports private fields/methods
     and the `#x in obj` brand-check form.

Only v99.hbc exists in this directory; tests/fixtures/build.sh skips v84/v94/v96
for this fixture, matching this file.
